exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.short_description: Foundational horizontal push for overall chest mass.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench, grip barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly above your chest with arms fully extended.
Lower the bar in a controlled arc to your mid-chest, elbows at ~45°.
Press forcefully back to the start, exhaling at the top.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
exercises.short_description: Targets upper chest with an inclined barbell press.
instructions: Set bench to 30–45°, lie back and grip bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack and hold bar over upper chest.
Lower bar to upper chest, keeping elbows at ~45°.
Press back up powerfully to full extension.

exercises.name: Barbell Decline Press
exercises.short_description: Hits the lower chest with a declined angle.
instructions: Set bench to -15° decline, secure feet under pads.
Grip barbell slightly wider than shoulders and unrack.
Lower bar to lower chest with control.
Press back up to lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.short_description: Greater range of motion chest press for each side independently.
instructions: Lie flat on bench, hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms forward.
Press dumbbells up until arms are fully extended over your chest.
Lower slowly with control, elbows at ~45° to body.
Stop when upper arms are parallel to floor, then press again.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.short_description: Emphasises upper chest with independent arm movement.
instructions: Set bench to 30–45°, sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring dumbbells to shoulder level, palms facing forward.
Press both dumbbells up and slightly inward to meet at the top.
Lower with control back to start position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.short_description: Isolation fly for chest stretch and contraction.
instructions: Lie flat on bench, hold dumbbells above chest with palms facing each other, slight elbow bend.
Open arms wide in an arc, lowering dumbbells until you feel a chest stretch.
Reverse the arc, squeezing chest as dumbbells return to the top.
Keep the elbow angle constant throughout.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.short_description: Classic bodyweight chest and pushing exercise.
instructions: Start in a high plank: hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower chest toward the floor by bending elbows at ~45° to body.
Stop just before chest touches the floor.
Push back up to full arm extension, keeping core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.short_description: Elevates feet to shift emphasis to upper chest.
instructions: Place feet on an elevated surface (bench or step), hands on floor.
Maintain a straight body line from head to heels.
Lower chest toward floor, elbows at ~45°.
Press back up to full extension.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.short_description: Bodyweight dip leaning forward to target lower chest.
instructions: Grip parallel bars and hoist yourself up to the start position, arms extended.
Lean your torso forward ~30° and cross your feet.
Bend elbows and lower until shoulders are slightly below elbow level.
Press back up to full extension, maintaining the forward lean.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.short_description: Guided horizontal press for chest isolation.
instructions: Adjust seat so handles are at mid-chest height.
Grip handles with palms facing down or forward.
Press handles away until arms are nearly extended.
Return slowly to start, keeping tension on chest.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Machine
exercises.short_description: Isolation fly movement on a fixed-arc machine.
instructions: Sit with back flat against pad, forearms on the pads.
Start with arms open, elbows at shoulder height.
Bring pads together in front of chest, squeezing pecs.
Return slowly to start, maintaining control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Push-Up
exercises.short_description: Push-up with added band resistance for progressive overload.
instructions: Drape a resistance band across your upper back, holding ends under each hand.
Start in a high plank position.
Lower chest to floor as in a standard push-up.
Press back up against the band's resistance.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Chest Fly
exercises.short_description: Standing fly using band for constant chest tension.
instructions: Anchor band at chest height behind you, one end in each hand.
Stand with arms outstretched to sides, slight elbow bend.
Bring hands together in front of chest in a hugging motion.
Slowly return to start, controlling band tension.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Floor Press
exercises.short_description: Chest press performed on the floor with kettlebells.
instructions: Lie on the floor, hold a kettlebell in each hand at chest level.
Press both kettlebells straight up until arms are extended.
Lower with control until triceps touch the floor.
Press again from the dead stop position.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Chest Press (Bench)
exercises.short_description: Flat bench press with kettlebells for extra wrist rotation.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, a kettlebell in each hand at chest level.
Press both up, rotating wrists so palms face each other at the top.
Lower slowly, rotating back to start position.
Keep core tight and feet flat on the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Skull Crusher
exercises.short_description: Lying triceps extension targeting all three heads.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, hold barbell with a narrow grip directly above forehead.
Keep upper arms vertical and stationary throughout.
Bend elbows to lower bar toward forehead or behind head.
Extend elbows to return to start.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
exercises.short_description: Narrow-grip bench press shifting load to triceps.
instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar with hands ~shoulder-width apart.
Unrack and hold bar over lower chest.
Lower bar to sternum keeping elbows tucked close to body.
Press back to full extension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.short_description: Overhead extension stretching the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Stand or sit, hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, arms extended.
Keep upper arms close to head and stationary.
Bend elbows to lower dumbbell behind head.
Extend elbows to return to start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Kickback
exercises.short_description: Isolation kickback for the lateral triceps head.
instructions: Hinge forward at hip, upper arm parallel to floor, elbow bent at 90°.
Keeping upper arm still, extend elbow until arm is straight.
Squeeze triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to 90° and repeat.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.short_description: Close-hand push-up emphasising triceps.
instructions: Place hands together under your chest, thumbs and forefingers touching to form a diamond.
Hold a straight plank position.
Lower chest toward hands, elbows track backward.
Push back to full extension.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.short_description: Bodyweight dip off a bench targeting the triceps.
instructions: Sit on edge of bench, hands gripping edge beside hips, fingers forward.
Slide off bench and support weight on hands, legs extended.
Lower hips toward floor by bending elbows to ~90°.
Push back up to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Machine Triceps Pushdown
exercises.short_description: Cable pushdown for isolated triceps work.
instructions: Stand at cable machine with a straight or rope attachment set at high pulley.
Grip attachment with overhand grip, elbows pinned at sides.
Push attachment down until arms are fully extended.
Slowly return to start, keeping elbows stationary.

exercises.name: Machine Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.short_description: Overhead cable extension for triceps long head.
instructions: Set cable pulley to low position, attach rope.
Face away from machine, hold rope overhead with both hands.
Keep upper arms next to ears, extend elbows fully.
Return slowly to 90° bend.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Triceps Pushdown
exercises.short_description: Band version of the cable pushdown, great for home training.
instructions: Anchor band overhead at a door or rack.
Grip band with overhand grip, elbows at sides.
Extend elbows fully pushing band downward.
Return to 90° with control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.short_description: Single kettlebell held overhead to target triceps.
instructions: Hold one kettlebell by the horns overhead, arms fully extended.
Keep upper arms stationary beside head.
Bend elbows to lower kettlebell behind head.
Extend arms back to start.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.short_description: Standing or seated press for total shoulder development.
instructions: Grip barbell just outside shoulder width, bar resting on upper chest.
Brace core, press bar directly overhead until arms lock out.
Move head slightly back to allow bar to pass, then reset under bar.
Lower bar back to upper chest with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Upright Row
exercises.short_description: Compound pull targeting lateral delts and traps.
instructions: Hold barbell with overhand grip, hands ~shoulder-width apart.
Pull bar straight up, leading with elbows, until bar reaches chin.
Keep bar close to body throughout the movement.
Lower with control to the start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.short_description: Seated or standing press for all three deltoid heads.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, hold dumbbells at shoulder level, palms forward.
Press dumbbells up and slightly inward until arms are fully extended.
Lower back to shoulder level with control.
Keep core braced, avoid arching lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.short_description: Isolation raise for the lateral deltoid head.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides, slight bend in elbows.
Raise arms out to the side until level with shoulders.
Tilt pinky slightly higher than thumb at the top (pouring motion).
Lower slowly with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.short_description: Targets the anterior deltoid with a forward raise.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of thighs, palms facing body.
Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height.
Keep a slight elbow bend throughout.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.short_description: Bodyweight shoulder press alternative in a pike position.
instructions: Start in a downward-dog position, hips high, forming an inverted V.
Bend elbows to lower head toward floor between hands.
Push back up by extending arms fully.
Keep hips elevated throughout.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Up
exercises.short_description: Advanced vertical press using full bodyweight.
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall, hands ~shoulder-width apart.
Lower head toward floor by bending elbows.
Stop just before head touches floor.
Press back up to full extension.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.short_description: Guided overhead press for beginners or high-volume work.
instructions: Adjust seat so handles are at shoulder height.
Grip handles with palms facing forward.
Press handles overhead until arms are nearly extended.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.short_description: Guided lateral raise for lateral delt isolation.
instructions: Sit at lateral raise machine, adjust arm pads to elbow level.
Press pads outward and upward to shoulder height.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to start.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Lateral Raise
exercises.short_description: Band lateral raise for shoulder width.
instructions: Stand on resistance band, hold one end in each hand at sides.
Raise arms out to sides to shoulder height.
Keep elbows slightly bent throughout.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Shoulder Press
exercises.short_description: Standing overhead press with a resistance band.
instructions: Stand on center of band, grip ends at shoulder height.
Press both hands overhead until arms are extended.
Lower back to shoulder level.
Keep core tight and avoid excessive back arch.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Press
exercises.short_description: Single-arm press demanding core stability.
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the rack position at shoulder level.
Press kettlebell straight up until arm is locked out.
Lower under control back to rack position.
Keep wrist straight and elbow under the bell throughout.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Upright Row
exercises.short_description: Kettlebell version of upright row targeting delts and traps.
instructions: Hold kettlebell with both hands, overhand grip, in front of thighs.
Pull kettlebell straight up, leading with elbows, to chin level.
Keep bell close to body.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.short_description: Compound row for overall back thickness.
instructions: Stand with hip-width stance, hinge at hips to ~45°, hold barbell with overhand grip.
Keep back flat and neutral spine throughout.
Pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen, leading with elbows.
Lower with control to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Barbell Pendlay Row
exercises.short_description: Strict row from a dead stop for explosive pulling power.
instructions: Set up like a bent-over row but torso is parallel to the floor.
Bar rests on floor each rep.
Explosively pull bar to lower chest, keeping torso horizontal.
Lower bar completely to floor before the next rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.short_description: Unilateral row allowing greater range of motion.
instructions: Place one knee and hand on a bench for support, hold a dumbbell in the other hand.
Start with arm hanging straight down.
Pull dumbbell up to hip level, leading with elbow.
Lower with full extension and repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
exercises.short_description: Targets the posterior deltoid and upper back.
instructions: Hinge forward at hips to ~90°, hold dumbbells below chest, palms facing each other.
Raise arms out to sides with a slight elbow bend.
Squeeze rear delts at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.short_description: Bodyweight horizontal pull targeting the upper back.
instructions: Set a bar at hip height, lie underneath it and grip it with overhand grip.
Body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Pull chest up to bar by driving elbows back.
Lower with control until arms are extended.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.short_description: Cable or band pull targeting rear delts and rotator cuff.
instructions: Set cable or attach band at face height.
Grip rope or band with overhand grip, step back.
Pull toward face, spreading hands apart at the end.
Externally rotate so thumbs point back, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.short_description: Horizontal cable row for mid-back thickness.
instructions: Sit at cable row station, feet on platform, slight knee bend.
Grip handle, sit tall with neutral spine.
Pull handle to lower abdomen, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Extend arms fully back to start.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Row
exercises.short_description: Seated or standing band row for upper back.
instructions: Anchor band at chest height or sit and loop around feet.
Hold ends with overhand grip, sit tall.
Pull hands to sides of torso, squeezing shoulder blades.
Return to full extension.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Rear Delt Fly
exercises.short_description: Band reverse fly for posterior deltoid and rhomboids.
instructions: Anchor band at chest height, grip with both hands, arms extended forward.
Pull arms apart horizontally, keeping slight elbow bend.
Squeeze rear delts at full extension.
Return to start slowly.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Bent-Over Row
exercises.short_description: Unilateral or bilateral kettlebell row for upper back.
instructions: Hinge at hips, hold a kettlebell in one hand, opposite hand on knee for support.
Pull kettlebell to hip level, driving elbow back.
Lower to full extension.
Complete reps on one side before switching.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.short_description: Classic mass-builder for the biceps.
instructions: Stand holding barbell with underhand grip at hip width.
Keep upper arms stationary at sides.
Curl bar up toward chin by flexing elbows.
Lower with control, fully extending arms at the bottom.

exercises.name: Barbell Preacher Curl
exercises.short_description: Strict curl on a preacher bench isolating the biceps.
instructions: Sit at preacher bench, rest upper arms on the angled pad.
Hold barbell with underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward shoulders.
Lower slowly until arms are nearly extended.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.short_description: Alternating or simultaneous curl for balanced biceps.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep upper arms still and curl both or alternate dumbbells toward shoulders.
Squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower with control to full extension.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.short_description: Neutral-grip curl targeting the brachialis for arm thickness.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms facing body (neutral grip).
Curl dumbbells to shoulder level without rotating wrist.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.short_description: Underhand pull-up heavily engaging the biceps.
instructions: Hang from a bar with underhand grip, hands ~shoulder-width apart.
Pull chest toward bar by driving elbows down and back.
Chin clears the bar at the top.
Lower with full control to a dead hang.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Curl (Underhand Inverted Row)
exercises.short_description: Bodyweight underhand row emphasising biceps.
instructions: Set bar at hip height, lie underneath with underhand grip.
Keep body straight, curl up pulling chest toward bar.
Lead with elbows, squeeze biceps at top.
Lower to full extension.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl
exercises.short_description: Guided preacher curl machine for strict bicep isolation.
instructions: Adjust seat so upper arms rest fully on angled pad.
Grip handles with underhand grip.
Curl to full flexion.
Lower slowly to near-full extension.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.short_description: Low-pulley cable curl with constant tension.
instructions: Stand at low cable pulley, grip bar or rope with underhand grip.
Keep upper arms stationary and curl toward shoulders.
Squeeze at top.
Lower under constant cable tension.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Curl
exercises.short_description: Band curl for biceps with constant resistance.
instructions: Stand on resistance band, grip ends with underhand grip.
Keep upper arms at sides.
Curl hands toward shoulders.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Hammer Curl
exercises.short_description: Neutral-grip band curl for brachialis thickness.
instructions: Stand on band, hold ends with palms facing each other.
Curl both hands toward shoulders maintaining neutral grip.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Curl
exercises.short_description: Kettlebell bilateral or alternating curl.
instructions: Hold kettlebells at sides with underhand grip on the handles.
Curl both or alternate to shoulder height.
Squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.short_description: King of lower body exercises for quad and glute mass.
instructions: Position barbell on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar).
Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Sit hips down and back, keeping chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Drive through heels to stand, fully extending hips and knees.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
exercises.short_description: More upright squat pattern placing greater demand on quads.
instructions: Rest barbell on front deltoids, elbows high and parallel to floor.
Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Squat deep, keeping elbows high and torso upright.
Stand back up by driving through the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.short_description: Beginner-friendly squat holding a dumbbell at chest.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically at chest height with both hands.
Stand feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Squat down, keeping chest up and elbows inside knees.
Drive up to standing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lunge
exercises.short_description: Unilateral leg exercise for quads, glutes, and balance.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides.
Step forward with one foot, lowering back knee toward the floor.
Front thigh reaches parallel to floor.
Push off front foot to return to standing and alternate legs.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.short_description: Fundamental movement pattern using only bodyweight.
instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width apart, arms forward for balance.
Lower hips down and back until thighs are parallel to floor.
Keep chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Stand back up, fully extending hips.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.short_description: Explosive squat jump for power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat, then explode upward as high as possible.
Land softly, bending knees to absorb impact.
Go straight into the next squat.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.short_description: Machine press targeting quads with reduced spinal load.
instructions: Sit in leg press machine, place feet shoulder-width on platform.
Release safety handles and lower platform by bending knees to 90°.
Press platform away until legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock knees at the top.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.short_description: Isolation machine exercise for the quadriceps.
instructions: Sit in leg extension machine, ankle pad just above feet.
Extend legs until nearly straight, squeezing quads.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control to 90° and repeat.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Squat
exercises.short_description: Squat with band above knees for glute activation.
instructions: Place resistance band just above knees.
Stand feet shoulder-width, push knees out against band.
Squat down to parallel or below.
Drive up, maintaining knee-out tension.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Leg Extension
exercises.short_description: Seated band extension for quad isolation at home.
instructions: Sit on a chair, anchor band low, loop around ankle.
Extend knee from 90° to full extension.
Squeeze quad at the top.
Return slowly to 90°.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
exercises.short_description: Front-loaded squat using a kettlebell for upright torso.
instructions: Hold kettlebell by horns at chest height.
Stand feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Squat deep, elbows track inside knees.
Stand up, fully extending hips.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Squat
exercises.short_description: Double kettlebell front rack squat for strength and stability.
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the rack position at shoulder level.
Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Squat down keeping elbows up and torso upright.
Stand back up, maintaining rack position.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Hip hinge targeting hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand holding barbell at hips with overhand grip.
Push hips back and lower bar along legs, keeping back flat.
Feel deep hamstring stretch at the bottom.
Drive hips forward to return to standing.

exercises.name: Barbell Good Morning
exercises.short_description: Barbell on upper back hip hinge for hamstrings.
instructions: Rest barbell on upper traps, feet hip-width.
Slight knee bend, hinge at hips pushing them back.
Lower torso until parallel to floor or hamstring limits.
Drive hips forward to return to upright.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Dumbbell hip hinge for hamstring stretch and strength.
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs, feet hip-width.
Push hips back, lowering dumbbells along legs.
Keep back flat and feel hamstring stretch.
Drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Stiff-Leg Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Straight-leg version emphasising hamstring stretch.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at thighs, legs nearly straight with slight bend.
Hinge at hips, lowering dumbbells toward floor.
Keep back flat throughout.
Return to standing by squeezing glutes and driving hips.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.short_description: Advanced eccentric bodyweight hamstring exercise.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with ankles anchored under something sturdy.
Keeping hips extended, slowly lower torso toward floor by straightening knees.
Use hands to catch yourself and push back up.
Use hamstrings to control the descent as much as possible.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl Machine
exercises.short_description: Prone machine curl for hamstring isolation.
instructions: Lie face down on machine, position ankle pad just above heels.
Curl legs toward glutes by flexing knees.
Squeeze hamstrings at full flexion.
Lower with control to full extension.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
exercises.short_description: Seated machine curl for hamstring isolation.
instructions: Sit in machine, position top pad on thighs and ankle pad above feet.
Flex knees pulling ankles back and down.
Squeeze at full flexion.
Return to start slowly.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Leg Curl
exercises.short_description: Prone band curl for hamstring isolation.
instructions: Anchor band low, lie face down, loop band around ankles.
Curl ankles toward glutes against band resistance.
Squeeze hamstrings at top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Romanian Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Band hip hinge for hamstring stretch.
instructions: Stand on band, hold ends at thighs.
Hinge at hips, lowering hands along legs.
Feel the hamstring stretch.
Drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.short_description: Ballistic hip hinge for hamstrings and explosive power.
instructions: Stand feet hip-to-shoulder-width, hold kettlebell with both hands.
Hinge at hips and swing kettlebell back between legs.
Explosively drive hips forward, swinging kettlebell to chest height.
Let it swing back down and immediately hinge into the next rep.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Single or double kettlebell hip hinge.
instructions: Hold kettlebell(s) at hips, feet hip-width.
Push hips back, lowering kettlebell(s) along legs.
Keep back flat and feel hamstring stretch.
Drive hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.short_description: Primary glute builder with a barbell across the hips.
instructions: Sit on floor with upper back against bench, barbell across hip crease.
Plant feet flat on floor, hip-width apart.
Drive hips up until thighs are parallel to floor.
Squeeze glutes hard at the top, lower with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Wide-stance deadlift with greater glute engagement.
instructions: Stand with wide stance, toes pointed out, grip barbell inside legs.
Push floor away and drive hips through as bar passes knees.
Stand tall at top, hips and knees fully extended.
Lower bar back to floor with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.short_description: Hip thrust with a dumbbell on the hips.
instructions: Sit with upper back on bench, dumbbell on hip crease.
Feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive hips up, squeezing glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
exercises.short_description: Unilateral step-up for glutes, quads, and balance.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, stand in front of a bench or box.
Step up with one foot, pressing through the heel to stand on the box.
Bring other foot up to stand on box.
Step back down and repeat, alternating lead leg.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.short_description: Floor-based bodyweight glute isolation.
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat on floor hip-width apart.
Drive hips up by squeezing glutes.
Hold at top for 1–2 seconds.
Lower hips to floor and repeat.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.short_description: Unilateral bridge for glute strength and symmetry.
instructions: Lie on back, one knee bent with foot on floor, other leg extended.
Drive hips up using the planted leg, squeezing glute.
Hold at top briefly.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.short_description: Cable kickback for glute isolation.
instructions: Attach ankle strap to low cable pulley.
Face the machine, hold for support.
Kick attached leg back and up, squeezing glute.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Thrust
exercises.short_description: Guided hip thrust machine for glute loading.
instructions: Sit in hip thrust machine, position pad across hip crease.
Plant feet on platform.
Drive hips up against the resistance.
Squeeze glutes at the top and lower with control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Glute Bridge
exercises.short_description: Glute bridge with band above knees for abduction activation.
instructions: Lie on back, band just above knees, feet flat on floor.
Push knees out against band as you drive hips up.
Squeeze glutes and hold briefly.
Lower and repeat.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Kickback
exercises.short_description: Standing kickback with band for glute isolation.
instructions: Anchor band low, loop around ankle, face anchor point.
Kick leg back and up, squeezing glute.
Hold briefly.
Return to start and repeat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Hip hinge pattern with a kettlebell for posterior chain.
instructions: Stand over kettlebell, feet hip-width, toes beside bell.
Hinge at hips and grip the handle.
Drive through heels, extending hips and knees to stand.
Lower the bell back to floor with a controlled hinge.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Wide-stance kettlebell deadlift for glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with wide stance over kettlebell, toes pointed out.
Hinge and grip handle with both hands.
Drive hips through to stand, squeezing glutes.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise
exercises.short_description: Heavy calf raise with barbell across the back.
instructions: Place barbell on upper traps, stand with balls of feet on edge of a step.
Lower heels below step level for a full stretch.
Rise up on tiptoes as high as possible.
Pause at top, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
exercises.short_description: Seated version targeting the soleus.
instructions: Sit on bench, barbell resting on thighs just above knees.
Balls of feet on a raised surface.
Lower heels for a stretch.
Press up onto tiptoes and hold, then lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.short_description: Unilateral or bilateral calf raise holding dumbbells.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, stand with balls of feet on a step edge.
Lower heels below step for a full stretch.
Rise onto tiptoes.
Pause and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.short_description: Unilateral calf raise for greater intensity per leg.
instructions: Hold dumbbell in one hand, stand on that side foot on step edge.
Other hand holds wall for balance.
Lower heel below step.
Rise onto tiptoe, pause, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
exercises.short_description: No-equipment calf raise on a step.
instructions: Stand on edge of a step, heels off the edge.
Lower heels below step for a full stretch.
Rise onto tiptoes as high as possible.
Pause and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Bodyweight Calf Raise
exercises.short_description: Harder unilateral version of the bodyweight calf raise.
instructions: Stand on one foot on edge of a step.
Lower heel for a full stretch.
Rise onto tiptoe.
Pause and lower, complete all reps before switching.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise Machine
exercises.short_description: Machine version targeting the soleus (knee bent).
instructions: Sit at machine, place knees under pads and balls of feet on platform.
Lower heels for a stretch.
Press up onto tiptoes.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise Machine
exercises.short_description: Machine standing calf raise for gastrocnemius.
instructions: Stand in machine with shoulder pads in place, feet on platform.
Lower heels for full stretch.
Rise onto tiptoes.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Calf Raise
exercises.short_description: Seated band calf raise for home training.
instructions: Sit on floor with legs extended, loop band around balls of feet.
Flex feet (plantarflex) against band resistance.
Hold at full flexion.
Return to dorsiflexion slowly.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise
exercises.short_description: Calf raise holding a kettlebell for resistance.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one or both hands.
Stand on edge of a step.
Lower heels for full stretch.
Rise onto tiptoes and pause.

exercises.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
exercises.short_description: Seated wrist flexion exercise for forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit on bench, hold barbell with underhand grip, forearms on thighs.
Let wrists drop into extension.
Curl wrists up, flexing forearms.
Lower back to start slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
exercises.short_description: Overhand wrist extension for forearm extensors.
instructions: Sit on bench, hold barbell with overhand grip, forearms on thighs.
Let wrists drop into flexion.
Extend wrists upward.
Lower back to start.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
exercises.short_description: Unilateral forearm flexion exercise.
instructions: Sit, rest forearm on thigh, hold dumbbell with underhand grip.
Let wrist drop into extension.
Curl wrist upward.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
exercises.short_description: Overhand curl for forearms and brachioradialis.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with overhand grip.
Keep upper arms still and curl toward shoulders.
Squeeze at top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.short_description: Passive hang from a bar for grip and forearm endurance.
instructions: Jump up and grab a pull-up bar with overhand grip.
Let body hang with arms fully extended.
Relax shoulders and breathe steadily.
Hold for the target duration.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.short_description: Loaded carry for grip, forearms, and total body stability.
instructions: Pick up heavy dumbbells, kettlebells, or a trap bar at sides.
Stand tall, shoulders back, core braced.
Walk with controlled steps for the target distance or time.
Set weights down with a controlled hinge.

exercises.name: Plate Pinch
exercises.short_description: Pinch grip hold for finger and forearm strength.
instructions: Hold a weight plate between thumb and fingers of one hand.
Stand tall and hold for target time.
Switch hands and repeat.
Increase plate weight as grip improves.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl
exercises.short_description: Low cable wrist curl for forearm flexors.
instructions: Kneel or sit at low cable, hold bar with underhand grip, forearms on thighs.
Let wrist drop, then curl upward.
Squeeze at top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Wrist Curl
exercises.short_description: Band wrist flexion for forearm muscles.
instructions: Anchor band low, sit with forearm on thigh, hold band with underhand grip.
Let wrist drop into extension.
Curl wrist upward.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Farmers Carry
exercises.short_description: Kettlebell carry for grip and loaded walking endurance.
instructions: Pick up two heavy kettlebells at sides.
Walk with upright posture and braced core.
Keep shoulders pulled back and down.
Walk for target distance or time.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.short_description: The ultimate full-body strength lift.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, barbell over mid-foot.
Hinge down and grip bar just outside legs, back flat.
Drive through floor and extend hips and knees simultaneously.
Lock out hips and knees at top, lower bar with a controlled hinge.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Beginner-friendly deadlift variation with dumbbells.
instructions: Stand over dumbbells, feet hip-width.
Hinge and grip dumbbells just outside legs.
Drive through floor to stand, extending hips fully.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.short_description: Bodyweight hyperextension for lower back endurance.
instructions: Position yourself on a hyperextension bench, hips on pad, ankles under rollers.
Cross arms over chest or hold behind head.
Lower torso toward floor.
Raise torso until body is in a straight line — don't hyperextend.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.short_description: Prone lower back isometric hold.
instructions: Lie face down, arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Squeeze glutes and lower back.
Hold for target duration.

exercises.name: Back Extension Machine
exercises.short_description: Weighted machine hyperextension.
instructions: Sit in machine, secure ankles and position pad at hip.
Hold weight plate to chest.
Hinge forward at hips, lowering torso.
Extend back to upright, squeezing lower back.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.short_description: Cable hip hinge targeting lower back and glutes.
instructions: Face away from cable machine, low pulley with rope attachment between legs.
Grip rope with both hands, hinge at hips walking feet out.
Drive hips forward to stand, squeezing glutes.
Hinge back to start.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Good Morning
exercises.short_description: Band hip hinge for lower back and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand on band, loop over shoulders/neck.
Feet hip-width, slight knee bend.
Hinge forward at hips to near-parallel.
Drive hips through to return upright.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Deadlift (Lower Back Focus)
exercises.short_description: Hip hinge with a single kettlebell emphasising spinal extension.
instructions: Stand over kettlebell, feet hip-width.
Hinge, grip handle, maintain flat back.
Drive through heels to stand.
Lower with a controlled hinge, keeping lumbar neutral.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.short_description: Overhand pull-up for lat width.
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip, hands wider than shoulders.
Pull chest toward bar driving elbows down and back.
Chin clears bar at top.
Lower with full control to dead hang.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.short_description: Wider grip pull-up to emphasise lat stretch.
instructions: Hang from bar with grip wider than shoulder-width.
Pull until chin passes bar, focusing on lat contraction.
Lower with control.
Avoid kipping or swinging.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift (Lat Focus)
exercises.short_description: Engage lats by bracing against the bar during the pull.
instructions: Set up for conventional deadlift, feet hip-width.
Before pulling, pull shoulder blades down and in to engage lats.
Maintain lat tension throughout the pull.
Lock out hips and knees at top.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row (Underhand)
exercises.short_description: Supinated row shifting emphasis to lats and biceps.
instructions: Hinge at hips, hold barbell with underhand grip shoulder-width.
Pull bar to lower abdomen/belly button.
Drive elbows back and down toward hips.
Lower to full extension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.short_description: Overhead pull for lat stretch and expansion.
instructions: Lie perpendicular on a bench, upper back on bench, hips low.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above chest.
Lower dumbbell in an arc behind head, feeling lat stretch.
Pull back to start using lats.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row (Elbow Flare)
exercises.short_description: Elbow-flared row to maximise lat engagement.
instructions: Support one hand on bench, hinge forward.
Hold dumbbell and pull it up and out — elbow flares wide.
Squeeze lat at top.
Lower to full extension.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.short_description: Cable pulldown targeting lat width.
instructions: Sit at lat pulldown machine, grip bar wider than shoulder-width.
Lean back slightly, pull bar to upper chest.
Drive elbows down and back.
Return to full arm extension with control.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.short_description: Narrow grip to emphasise lower lat and biceps.
instructions: Grip handle with neutral close grip.
Pull to upper chest, elbows track to sides.
Squeeze lats at the bottom.
Return to full extension.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Lat Pulldown
exercises.short_description: Band pulldown for lats at home.
instructions: Anchor band overhead.
Kneel or sit, grip band with wide overhand grip.
Pull hands down to upper chest.
Return to full extension.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
exercises.short_description: Band pull-apart for lats, rear delts, and upper back.
instructions: Hold band with overhand grip at shoulder height.
Pull band apart horizontally until it touches chest.
Squeeze lats and rear delts.
Return to start slowly.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Pullover
exercises.short_description: Overhead pull with kettlebell for lat expansion.
instructions: Lie on bench, hold kettlebell by horns above chest.
Lower kettlebell in arc behind head.
Feel lat stretch at the bottom.
Pull back to start using lats.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Row
exercises.short_description: Unilateral kettlebell row for lats and upper back.
instructions: Hinge forward, one hand on knee for support.
Hold kettlebell in other hand, arm hanging.
Pull kettlebell to hip, driving elbow back.
Lower to full extension.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.short_description: Heavy shrug for trap mass.
instructions: Hold barbell with overhand grip at hip level.
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears.
Hold at the top for 1 second.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Power Clean
exercises.short_description: Olympic pull engaging traps explosively.
instructions: Start in deadlift position, grip just outside hips.
Explosively extend hips, knees, and ankles (triple extension).
Shrug shoulders hard, then pull elbows high and outside.
Drop under bar into a front rack, stand to finish.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.short_description: Dumbbell trap isolation with full range of motion.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, arms straight.
Shrug shoulders directly upward.
Hold at top briefly.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Upright Row
exercises.short_description: Pull dumbbells up engaging traps and lateral delts.
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of thighs, overhand grip.
Pull elbows up and wide, raising dumbbells to chin.
Keep dumbbells close to body.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Scapular Retraction
exercises.short_description: Hanging retraction drill for trap activation.
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar with overhand grip.
Without bending elbows, pull shoulder blades together and down.
Hold for 1–2 seconds.
Release and repeat.

exercises.name: Shrug (Trap Bar)
exercises.short_description: Trap bar shrug for heavy trap loading.
instructions: Step inside trap bar and grip handles.
Stand tall, then shrug shoulders directly upward.
Hold at top briefly.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Cable Shrug
exercises.short_description: Cable shrug for constant trap tension.
instructions: Stand at cable machine with straight bar at low pulley.
Hold bar at sides, arms extended.
Shrug shoulders upward.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Shrug
exercises.short_description: Band shrug for trap endurance.
instructions: Stand on band, hold ends at sides.
Shrug shoulders upward.
Hold briefly.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Face Pull
exercises.short_description: Band face pull for traps and rear delts.
instructions: Anchor band at face height.
Grip with both hands, step back.
Pull toward face, spreading hands apart.
Return slowly to full extension.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Shrug
exercises.short_description: Shrug with kettlebells at sides.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at sides.
Shrug shoulders upward toward ears.
Hold for 1 second.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell High Pull
exercises.short_description: Explosive kettlebell upright pull for traps and shoulders.
instructions: Hold kettlebell with both hands, deadlift it off the floor.
Swing it up explosively, pulling elbows high.
Bell reaches chest height at the top.
Lower and swing back between legs for the next rep.

exercises.name: Barbell Rollout
exercises.short_description: Extreme core anti-extension exercise with a barbell.
instructions: Load barbell with small plates, kneel on mat.
Grip bar with overhand grip, shoulders over bar.
Roll bar forward, extending hips and keeping core braced.
Pull bar back to start using abs and lats.

exercises.name: Barbell Pallof Press
exercises.short_description: Anti-rotation press for core stability.
instructions: Attach band or cable to barbell at chest height, stand sideways.
Hold bar at chest, brace core.
Press bar straight out, resisting rotation.
Return to chest.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.short_description: Classic isometric core stability hold.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank, elbows under shoulders.
Keep body in a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze glutes, brace abs, breathe steadily.
Hold for target duration.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.short_description: Lateral isometric hold for obliques.
instructions: Lie on side, prop up on forearm with elbow under shoulder.
Stack feet or stagger for balance.
Raise hips to create a straight line.
Hold for target duration, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.short_description: Basic abdominal flexion exercise.
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, hands behind head.
Curl shoulders off floor, exhaling as you crunch up.
Feel abs contract at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.short_description: Hanging lower ab raise for core and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a bar with overhand grip.
Keeping upper body still, raise knees toward chest.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.short_description: Advanced hanging raise with straight legs.
instructions: Hang from bar, legs straight.
Raise legs to parallel or above, keeping them straight.
Control the descent, avoid swinging.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.short_description: Weighted crunch using a cable for progressive overload.
instructions: Kneel at cable machine with rope attachment at high pulley.
Hold rope beside head, elbows forward.
Crunch down, bringing elbows toward knees.
Return to upright with control.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.short_description: Anti-rotation cable press for core stability.
instructions: Set cable at chest height, stand sideways, grip with both hands.
Hold at chest, brace core.
Press straight out, resist rotation.
Return to chest and repeat.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pallof Press
exercises.short_description: Band anti-rotation press for core stability.
instructions: Anchor band at chest height, stand sideways.
Hold band with both hands at chest.
Press straight out, resisting rotation.
Return to chest.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Dead Bug
exercises.short_description: Banded dead bug for anti-extension core control.
instructions: Lie on back, anchor band overhead, hold with both arms extended.
Raise knees to 90°.
Lower one leg toward floor while maintaining band tension.
Return and alternate sides.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Windmill
exercises.short_description: Lateral bend under a kettlebell for obliques and shoulder stability.
instructions: Press kettlebell overhead with one arm, locked out.
Turn feet 45° away from pressing arm.
Push hip out in the direction of pressing arm, lean sideways.
Reach free hand toward floor, then return upright.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
exercises.short_description: Full-body movement demanding core control.
instructions: Lie on floor holding kettlebell above one shoulder, arm locked.
Roll to elbow, then hand, sweep leg through to kneeling.
Stand up while keeping kettlebell overhead throughout.
Reverse the sequence to return to lying.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
exercises.short_description: Seated rotational exercise for obliques.
instructions: Sit on floor, knees bent, hold dumbbell with both hands.
Lean back slightly to engage core.
Rotate torso left and right, touching dumbbell to floor each side.
Keep feet off the floor for added difficulty.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
exercises.short_description: Lateral flexion for obliques.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbell in one hand at side.
Bend laterally toward the dumbbell side.
Return upright, feel oblique stretch on opposite side.
Complete all reps then switch sides.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.short_description: Ab wheel anti-extension for the entire core.
instructions: Kneel holding ab wheel with both hands, arms extended.
Roll forward slowly, extending hips and keeping core tight.
Go as far as you can without hips sagging.
Pull back to start using abs and lats.

exercises.name: V-Up
exercises.short_description: Simultaneous upper and lower ab crunch.
instructions: Lie flat, arms extended overhead, legs straight.
Simultaneously lift arms and legs toward each other.
Reach hands toward feet at the top.
Lower both back to floor with control.

exercises.name: Treadmill Run
exercises.short_description: Steady-state or interval running on a treadmill.
instructions: Set desired speed and incline on the treadmill.
Start with a 2–3 minute warm-up walk.
Maintain target pace, keep shoulders relaxed and arms swinging.
Cool down with a 2–3 minute walk at the end.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike
exercises.short_description: Low-impact cardio on a stationary cycle.
instructions: Adjust seat so leg has slight bend at full extension.
Set resistance level.
Pedal at a steady cadence, keeping back upright.
Maintain target pace for the session duration.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.short_description: Full-body cardio on the rowing ergometer.
instructions: Sit on the erg, strap feet in, grip handle overhand.
Push through legs first, then lean back, then pull handle to lower chest.
Return by extending arms, leaning forward, then bending knees.
Maintain a smooth catch-drive-finish-recover rhythm.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.short_description: High-intensity cardio with a skipping rope.
instructions: Hold rope handles, jump rope behind feet.
Swing rope overhead and jump as it passes under feet.
Stay on balls of feet, keep jumps low and efficient.
Maintain rhythm for target duration.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.short_description: Full-body conditioning exercise.
instructions: Stand, then drop hands to floor and jump feet back to a push-up position.
Perform a push-up.
Jump feet forward, stand up, and jump with arms overhead.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.short_description: Running-motion plank for cardio and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward chest.
Quickly switch legs in a running motion.
Keep hips level and core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.short_description: Plyometric jump onto a box for power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box, feet shoulder-width.
Drop into a quarter squat and swing arms back.
Explode upward, swinging arms forward and landing softly on box.
Step down carefully and reset.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Snatch
exercises.short_description: Full-body ballistic movement for power and cardio conditioning.
instructions: Hold kettlebell in one hand, hinge at hips in a swing position.
Hike bell back between legs, then explosively drive hips forward.
Guide bell upward, punch through at the top to lock out overhead.
Lower bell back to swing position and repeat.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.short_description: Pushing a weighted sled for power endurance.
instructions: Load sled with desired weight.
Grip handles at hip height, lean forward at ~45°.
Drive hard with alternating leg strides, staying low.
Push for target distance.

exercises.name: Outdoor Run
exercises.short_description: Running outside at steady or variable pace.
instructions: Warm up with a 3-minute walk or easy jog.
Run at your target pace, keeping posture upright.
Land midfoot, arms swinging at roughly 90°.
Cool down with a 3-minute walk.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl (Reverse Grip)
exercises.short_description: Overhand barbell curl for brachioradialis and forearms.
instructions: Hold barbell with overhand grip at hip width.
Keep upper arms still and curl toward shoulders.
Squeeze at top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Neutral-grip deadlift for overall strength with reduced lower back strain.
instructions: Stand inside trap bar, feet hip-width.
Grip handles, hinge to position: back flat, hips below shoulders.
Drive through floor, extending hips and knees together.
Lock out at top, then lower with a controlled hinge.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.short_description: Rear-foot elevated split squat for quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench, hold dumbbells at sides.
Place rear foot on the bench, laces down.
Lower front knee toward floor, keeping torso upright.
Drive through front heel to stand.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.short_description: Advanced bodyweight quad isolation squat.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, hold something for balance.
Rise onto tiptoes and lean back while bending knees.
Lower until shins are near parallel to floor.
Drive back up to start.

exercises.name: Hack Squat Machine
exercises.short_description: Angled machine squat for quad emphasis.
instructions: Position shoulders under pads, feet on platform shoulder-width.
Release safety and lower by bending knees to 90°.
Press back up, knees tracking over toes.
Do not lock knees at the top.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Hip Thrust
exercises.short_description: Hip thrust with band across hips for glute work.
instructions: Sit with upper back on bench, band across hip crease, ends anchored.
Feet flat on floor hip-width apart.
Drive hips up against band resistance, squeezing glutes.
Lower hips with control.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Bodyweight)
exercises.short_description: Unilateral hip hinge for hamstrings and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg, slight knee bend.
Hinge forward at hip, extending free leg behind.
Lower torso toward parallel, feeling hamstring stretch.
Drive through planted heel to return upright.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.short_description: Machine-assisted posterior chain compound exercise.
instructions: Position yourself on the GHR machine, shins on roller pads.
Lower torso forward under control.
Use hamstrings and glutes to pull back to upright.
Keep hips extended throughout.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.short_description: Loaded unilateral hip hinge for hamstrings and balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in the opposite hand to the working leg.
Stand on one leg with slight knee bend.
Hinge forward, lowering dumbbell along the leg.
Drive through heel to return upright.

exercises.name: Barbell Lunge
exercises.short_description: Heavy loaded lunge with a barbell on the back.
instructions: Place barbell on upper traps, stand tall.
Step forward, lowering back knee toward floor.
Front thigh reaches parallel.
Push off front foot to return and alternate.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Lunge
exercises.short_description: Lunge holding kettlebells at sides.
instructions: Hold kettlebells at sides.
Step forward, lower back knee toward floor.
Push off front foot to return.
Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pull-Up Assist
exercises.short_description: Band-assisted pull-up for building to full pull-up.
instructions: Loop resistance band around bar and place knee or foot in loop.
Hang from bar with overhand grip.
Pull chest toward bar with band assisting.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Bicep Curl (Seated)
exercises.short_description: Seated band curl for strict bicep isolation.
instructions: Sit on bench, stand on band, hold ends with underhand grip.
Keep upper arms still at sides.
Curl both hands toward shoulders.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Machine Row
exercises.short_description: Chest-supported machine row for upper back.
instructions: Set chest pad against sternum, grip handles.
Pull handles to sides of torso, squeezing shoulder blades.
Hold briefly.
Return to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Dip (Triceps)
exercises.short_description: Upright bodyweight dip targeting triceps.
instructions: Grip parallel bars, arms extended, body upright.
Lower by bending elbows, keeping torso vertical.
Upper arms reach parallel to floor.
Press back up to full extension.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.short_description: Rotating dumbbell press hitting all three delt heads.
instructions: Sit with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you.
As you press up, rotate palms outward.
Reach full extension with palms facing forward.
Reverse the rotation as you lower.

exercises.name: Barbell Wrist Roller
exercises.short_description: Forearm endurance using a wrist roller.
instructions: Grip roller bar with both hands, arms extended forward.
Roll weight up by alternately flexing wrists.
Unwind back down slowly.
Keep arms parallel to floor throughout.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.short_description: Angled barbell press for shoulder-friendly pressing.
instructions: Fix one end of barbell in a landmine or corner.
Stand and hold the other end at shoulder level.
Press the bar forward and up at an angle.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Clean
exercises.short_description: Power clean with a kettlebell to build explosiveness.
instructions: Hold kettlebell in one hand, hinge at hips.
Swing bell back, then explosively drive hips forward.
Guide bell upward and catch it in the rack position.
Lower to swing and repeat.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Triceps Overhead Extension
exercises.short_description: Band overhead extension for triceps long head.
instructions: Anchor band low behind you, grip with both hands behind head.
Keep upper arms next to ears.
Extend elbows overhead.
Return to 90° with control.

exercises.name: Machine Triceps Dip
exercises.short_description: Assisted or weighted machine dip for triceps.
instructions: Adjust machine weight, sit with hands on handles.
Press handles downward extending elbows.
Full extension at bottom.
Return with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
exercises.short_description: Incline bench curl for maximum bicep stretch.
instructions: Set bench to 45–60°, sit back with dumbbells hanging at sides.
Curl both dumbbells up, keeping upper arms back against pad.
Squeeze at top.
Lower to full extension, feeling the stretch.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.short_description: Single-arm cable raise for consistent lateral delt tension.
instructions: Stand sideways at low cable, hold handle in far hand.
Raise arm out to shoulder height, slight elbow bend.
Hold briefly.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat (Pulse)
exercises.short_description: Isometric hold at the bottom of goblet squat.
instructions: Hold kettlebell at chest, lower into squat.
Hold position at parallel or below.
Small pulses up and down while holding position.
Maintain time under tension for target duration.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Clamshell
exercises.short_description: Hip abductor activation for glutes and hip health.
instructions: Lie on side, band just above knees, knees bent at 90°.
Keep feet together and rotate top knee upward.
Open as far as possible without rotating hips.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Extension
exercises.short_description: Weighted hyperextension holding a barbell.
instructions: Position on hyperextension bench, hold barbell across upper chest.
Hinge at hips, lowering torso.
Extend back to neutral — do not hyperextend.
Squeeze lower back and glutes at top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
exercises.short_description: Strict seated curl for peak bicep contraction.
instructions: Sit on bench, elbow braced against inner thigh.
Hold dumbbell with underhand grip, arm hanging.
Curl toward shoulder, squeeze at peak.
Lower to full extension.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Upright Row
exercises.short_description: Band upright row for delts and traps.
instructions: Stand on band, grip with overhand grip close together.
Pull upward, leading with elbows to chin level.
Keep band close to body.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Floor Press
exercises.short_description: Floor-based press limiting range of motion for elbow safety.
instructions: Lie on floor with barbell in a rack above you.
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower bar until triceps touch floor.
Press back to lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Fly (Incline)
exercises.short_description: Incline fly for upper chest isolation.
instructions: Set bench to 30–45°, hold dumbbells above chest, palms facing.
Open arms wide in an arc, lowering until chest stretch.
Reverse arc, squeezing upper chest.
Keep elbow bend constant.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing (Single Arm)
exercises.short_description: Unilateral kettlebell swing for anti-rotation core work.
instructions: Hold kettlebell in one hand, hinge at hips.
Hike bell back between legs.
Drive hips forward explosively, swinging bell to chest height.
Control the descent back into the hinge.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Deadlift
exercises.short_description: Deadlift pattern with a resistance band.
instructions: Stand on band, grip ends at sides.
Hinge at hips, back flat.
Drive through heels to stand, extending hips fully.
Lower with a controlled hinge.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.short_description: Gymnastics core anti-extension isometric.
instructions: Lie on back, press lower back into floor.
Extend arms overhead and legs out low.
Hold the position, lower back stays flat.
Breathe steadily throughout.

exercises.name: L-Sit Hold
exercises.short_description: Advanced isometric hold requiring core and hip flexor strength.
instructions: Sit on floor with hands beside hips, palms flat.
Straighten arms and lift hips off floor.
Extend legs straight in front, parallel to floor.
Hold for target duration.

exercises.name: Barbell Zercher Squat
exercises.short_description: Bar held in the crook of elbows for an upright squat.
instructions: Set barbell at hip height in a rack, position in the crook of elbows.
Stand tall, feet shoulder-width.
Squat deep keeping chest up and elbows up.
Stand back up, maintaining barbell position.

exercises.name: Machine Leg Press (Single Leg)
exercises.short_description: Unilateral leg press for quad and glute strength.
instructions: Sit in leg press, place one foot on center of platform.
Lower platform to 90°.
Press back to near extension.
Complete all reps then switch legs.
